issues.issue: Is the claimant excluded under Article 1E because of his Bahamian permanent residence?
issues.respondent_position: Bahamian permanent residence confers rights similar to nationals, so Article 1E applies.
issues.result_text: Claimant is excluded under Article 1E due to permanent resident status in the Bahamas.

issues.issue: Is there a well-founded fear of persecution in the Bahamas because of sexual orientation?
issues.applicant_position: Persecuted and assaulted in the Bahamas for being homosexual; police were hostile.
issues.respondent_position: No subjective fear: abandoned Bahamian status and made many trips without claiming in the US.
issues.result_text: Not enough evidence of reasonable fear of persecution in the Bahamas due to sexual orientation.
